license.obligation: Preserve copyright and MIT notice with copied/substantially derived code.

scope.supporting_ui: Reuse existing fork equivalents for components/ui; site/MDX/registry build are distribution infrastructure.

quality.assessment_method: Source inspection only; web build and runtime tests not executed

components.name: prompt-input
components.description: An input field designed for chat interfaces, allowing users to enter and submit text prompts to an AI model
behavior: Controlled/uncontrolled text, autosizing to maxHeight, Enter submit, Shift+Enter newline
Container click focuses input; action tooltip trigger stops container click; disabled input
acceptance: Enter once, Shift+Enter newline, IME composing Enter does not send
upstream_findings: Enter unconditionally calls onSubmit without isComposing or loading guard
isLoading only stored in context, never consulted
Example custom onKeyDown calls submit a second time

components.name: code-block
components.description: A component for displaying code snippets with syntax highlighting and customizable styling
behavior: Plain initial fallback, optional group/header/footer slots, horizontal scrolling
upstream_findings: codeToHtml async work has no catch or stale-result guard

components.name: markdown
components.description: A component for rendering Markdown content with support for code blocks, GFM, and custom styling
behavior: Soft breaks rendered as breaks; fenced vs inline code
acceptance: Safe links and inert raw HTML
upstream_findings: Block comparator ignores components renderer changes
Parses twice using marked lexer then react-markdown

components.name: message
components.description: A component for displaying chat messages with support for avatars, markdown content, and interactive actions
behavior: Avatar required alt plus fallback and delay

components.name: chat-container
components.description: A component for creating chat interfaces with intelligent auto-scrolling behavior, designed to provide a smooth and responsive user experience
behavior: Initial bottom and smooth following when content grows
Manual scroll away suspends follow until return
Log role and optional bottom anchor
acceptance: Initial bottom, append and streaming growth follow

components.name: scroll-button
components.description: A floating button component that appears when users scroll up in a container, allowing them to quickly return to the bottom of the content
behavior: Animated visibility according to chat isAtBottom
upstream_findings: Opacity-zero/pointer-events-none button remains tabbable
Default icon button lacks accessible label

components.name: loader
components.description: A component for displaying a loading indicator with multiple variants and customizable styling
behavior: 12 variants: circular, classic, pulse, pulse-dot, dots, typing, wave, bars, terminal, text-blink, text-shimmer, loading-dots
Custom text; nontext variants Loading alternative
upstream_findings: No reduced-motion treatment in component source

components.name: prompt-suggestion
components.description: A component for implementing interactive prompt suggestions in AI interfaces. The PromptSuggestion component offers two distinct modes: Normal Mode and Highlight Mode.
behavior: Normal pill or first case-insensitive substring highlighted mode
Preserves source case and whitespace; blank highlight normal mode

components.name: response-stream
components.description: A component to simulate streaming text on the client side, perfect for fake responses, or any controlled progressive text display.
behavior: Displayed text/segments/completion state; start/reset/pause/resume controls; errors
acceptance: Errors, Unicode graphemes, speed limits, latest callbacks
upstream_findings: Fade invokes onComplete from hook and final animation handler
Reset/start do not abort previous async iterator
Pause only stops requestAnimationFrame, not async source
String slicing may split surrogate pairs

components.name: reasoning
components.description: A collapsible component for showing AI reasoning, explanations, or logic. You can control it manually or let it auto-close when the stream ends. Markdown is supported.
behavior: Uncontrolled stream start opens and stream end closes
acceptance: Stream lifecycle and manual override policy
upstream_findings: Plain trigger lacks aria-expanded/controls
Collapsed maxHeight=0 subtree stays in DOM without inert/aria-hidden

components.name: file-upload
components.description: A component for creating drag-and-drop file upload interfaces with support for single or multiple files, custom triggers, and visual feedback during file dragging operations.
behavior: Disabled, file callback, repeat same selection
upstream_findings: Global drop listeners ignore disabled when delivering files
accept applies to input but not dropped files
All instances attach window listeners

components.name: jsx-preview
components.description: A component for rendering JSX strings as React components, with support for streaming content and automatic tag completion.
behavior: JSX string rendered by react-jsx-parser with component bindings/props
compose_mapping: Actual isolated web JSX preview host OR explicitly documented native declarative format adapter
acceptance: Real interactive JSX rendering if claiming equivalence
upstream_findings: Regex completion drops text after last matched tag and pops stack without matching names
No direct commonMain Compose equivalent; displaying source alone is not a faithful port

components.name: tool
components.description: Displays tool call details including input, output, status, and errors. Ideal for visualizing AI tool usage in chat UIs.
behavior: State icon/badge, formatted data, errors, bounded output
acceptance: All four states retain expansion through changes
Long output scroll and error/status semantics

components.name: source
components.description: Displays website sources used by AI-generated content, showing URL details, titles, and descriptions on hover.
behavior: Link and optional trigger favicon; preview always favicon
acceptance: Exact URL callback and safe schemes
upstream_findings: Google favicon service receives full source href; mandatory in preview

components.name: image
components.description: A component for displaying images from base64 or Uint8Array data, with full accessibility and responsive styling. Perfect for AI-generated or user-uploaded images.
behavior: Base64 or byte array plus MIME; base64 preferred
Required alt; responsive rounded image; missing-data placeholder

components.name: steps
components.description: A component for displaying a sequence of operations in a collapsible layout. Each step can include details and an optional vertical bar. Useful for showing AI steps like reasoning traces, tool calls, or process logs.
behavior: Animated details items and replaceable vertical bar

components.name: system-message
components.description: A banner-style component for surfacing contextual information, warnings, or instructions within AI interfaces.
acceptance: Three variants x two fill styles
upstream_findings: cta.variant declared but ignored: always default button

components.name: chain-of-thought
components.description: A component for displaying a chain of thought process with collapsible steps and triggers.
behavior: Trigger icon/hover swap and body slots

components.name: text-shimmer
components.description: A component for displaying a shimmer effect on text, perfect for loading states or highlighting text.
behavior: Animated text gradient; custom duration; spread clamped 5..45
upstream_findings: No reduced-motion treatment

components.name: thinking-bar
components.description: A component to display the thinking state of an AI model with optional actions.
behavior: Shimmer label optionally clickable for details
Optional stop/answer-now callback and custom label

components.name: feedback-bar
components.description: A component to collect user feedback on AI responses.
behavior: Helpful, not-helpful and close named callbacks
acceptance: Selected feedback is optional extension, not upstream built-in

blocks.name: conversation-actions
blocks.behavior: Static conversation with copy/upvote/downvote buttons. Buttons are illustrative, not wired to clipboard or backend.
blocks.compose_mapping: Reusable composition/demo; hoist data and provide callbacks for all visible actions.

blocks.behavior: Static conversation with assistant/user avatars and markdown body.
blocks.compose_mapping: Reusable composition/demo; hoist data and provide callbacks for all visible actions.

blocks.compose_mapping: Reusable composition/demo; hoist data and provide callbacks for all visible actions.

blocks.name: full-conversation

blocks.compose_mapping: Reusable composition/demo; hoist data and provide callbacks for all visible actions.

blocks.behavior: Case-insensitive fixed-list suggestions and match highlighting. Suggestions lack onClick; submit logs to console.
blocks.compose_mapping: Reusable composition/demo; hoist data and provide callbacks for all visible actions.

blocks.behavior: Composer with attach/search/more/voice/send buttons; timed fake loading; auxiliary buttons unwired.
blocks.compose_mapping: Reusable composition/demo; hoist data and provide callbacks for all visible actions.

blocks.behavior: Suggestion categories/items set composer input; submission clears text/category and logs to console.
blocks.compose_mapping: Reusable composition/demo; hoist data and provide callbacks for all visible actions.

blocks.compose_mapping: Reusable composition/demo; hoist data and provide callbacks for all visible actions.

primitives.name: chatbot
primitives.behavior: AI SDK useChat + DefaultChatTransport to local Next API. Server calls OpenAI gpt-4.1-nano with sample date/time tools. Tool-calling adds up-to-five-step loop and Tool presentation.
primitives.compose_mapping: Provider-neutral ChatSession state/events and injectable transport; host supplies backend. No secret in native UI or mandatory OpenAI.
acceptance: Stable ordered text and tool parts

primitives.behavior: AI SDK useChat + DefaultChatTransport to local Next API. Server calls OpenAI gpt-4.1-nano with sample date/time tools. Tool-calling adds up-to-five-step loop and Tool presentation.
primitives.compose_mapping: Provider-neutral ChatSession state/events and injectable transport; host supplies backend. No secret in native UI or mandatory OpenAI.
acceptance: Stable ordered text and tool parts
